name: om-agi
description: Oh My AGI — a CLI and web console that builds AGI agents you own: a soul of its own, memory recalled from your notes and documents, autonomy with a kill switch, A2A and Telegram, one git repo per agent, local-first.

scripts.build:macos: bun build bin/om-agi.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 --outfile dist/ohmyagi-darwin-arm64 && bun build bin/om-agi.ts --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 --outfile dist/ohmyagi-darwin-x64
scripts.release:check: test -n "$OM_AGI_RELEASE_MODEL" || { echo "release:check needs OM_AGI_RELEASE_MODEL=<local ollama model> — the identity firewall (S6.4) is judged against a real model, and a release without that judgement does not ship (D-062)" >&2; exit 1; } && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run coverage && OM_AGI_REAL_FIREWALL=1 OM_AGI_REAL_MODEL="$OM_AGI_RELEASE_MODEL" bun test test/soul/firewall.real.test.ts
